name: DRIVE: Digital Retinal Images for Vessel Extraction
description: A widely established biomedical benchmark dataset for evaluating retinal blood vessel segmentation algorithms in color fundus photography. Captured during a diabetic retinopathy screening programme in the Netherlands using a Canon CR5 non-mydriatic 3CCD camera. Comprises 40 eye photographs (33 non-diabetic retinopathy, 7 early diabetic retinopathy), each accompanied by manual vessel segmentations by two independent human observers. Safeguard notice: Intended strictly for non-commercial research and educational algorithm evaluation; not certified for direct diagnostic clinical use.
